name: Floral Acres
description: Floral Acres is a working farm in 1 Box 26E, WV. It grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples, with seasonal availability through spring, summer, and autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
